material_findings.title: CSAW Cyber Reasoning Challenge is a high-fit autonomous vulnerability discovery and repair competition
material_findings.summary: CSAW's primary competition page and its official CRC-CSAW repository describe an online AIxCC-style challenge where student teams submit an autonomous cyber reasoning system to find crashing proofs of vulnerability and produce compiling, behavior-preserving patches for released C/C++ targets. Registration closes Sep. 24 at 23:59 AoE, qualification runs Sep. 26-27, cash awards total $1,000, and top three teams are invited to submit a paper. The rules explicitly allow language models and agent systems while confining activity to released challenge targets/infrastructure. Current college/university student status and regional eligibility are mandatory, and entry cost was not stated on the checked primary surfaces.
material_findings.recommended_action: Do not create participant-specific active work until student/region eligibility and registration intent are established. If eligible, preserve the registration confirmation, exact released qualification challenge statements, frozen CRS revision and organizer rules in a structured case; treat only released CRC targets as authorized; design evaluation around autonomous PoV discovery, patch correctness, build/test preservation and reproducibility audit artifacts.

material_findings.title: Null Origin qualifier is primary-source verified as free and globally open
material_findings.summary: Null Origin's organizer page confirms a free worldwide 1-4 person qualifier on Sep. 18 at 10:00 IST for 12 hours, with finals Sep. 25. Its ₹10 lakh+ reward headline is explicitly described as a pool of training, certifications, labs, cloud credits and career opportunities, so it should not be represented as a ₹10 lakh cash purse.
material_findings.recommended_action: Keep as a legitimate near-term CTF option. Before creating a case, preserve the final challenge-platform rules and registration/team state; do not infer authorization beyond the dedicated competition environment.
